section.19: The Book of the Prayer for the Two 'Eids

19.name_native: The Book of the Prayer for the Two 'Eids

hadiths.text: It was narrated from 'Aishah that:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered upon her and there were two girls with her who were beating the duff. Abu Bakr scolded them, but the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Leave them, for every people has an 'Eid
